title: Measure the angle
summary: Read an angle off a protractor you drag and turn.
content:
## Using a protractor

Put the centre of the protractor on the corner of the angle and its baseline along one arm. Read where the other arm crosses the scale.

## Two scales

A protractor has two scales. Count from the 0 that sits on the arm under the baseline: an angle smaller than a right angle is less than 90°.

quiz.explanation: The angle is wider than a right angle, so it is more than 90°: 125°.
hints: Line up the baseline with one arm first.

quiz.explanation: The angle is narrower than a right angle, so it is less than 90°: 40°.
